title: Bilingual local shelter signboard
summary: A signboard template for shelters, apartment entrances, village squares, or camps where Greek and English visitors need the same water, toilet, quiet, and help information.
content: Core sequence: 1) Post only stable information: water point, toilets, quiet area, help desk, charging rule, and next update time. 2) Use short Greek and English lines with arrows or simple symbols instead of long paragraphs. 3) Remove expired notices immediately so visitors do not follow old instructions. 4) Keep private names off the public board unless a responsible official process requires them.
